pending_interview.question: You have a list of log entries, each containing a user ID and a timestamp. Users can appear multiple times. You need to find all pairs of users who visited within 5 minutes of each other at least twice on the same day — meaning there are at least two separate time windows on that day where both users were active within 5 minutes of each other simultaneously. Walk me through your approach: how you would structure the data, what data structures you would use, and what the time and space complexity of your solution would be. You do not need to write runnable code — reasoning through the algorithm clearly is the goal.
